newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon adds Pfizer to list.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon adds Pfizer to list.

text.p: Salomon Brother Inc chief equity strategist David Shulman said Wednesday the brokerage added pharmaceutical company Pfizer Inc to its large cap recommended list.
-- said the company has boosted research and development expenditures "and now has one of the best pipelines in the industry".
-- Salomon analyst Robert Uhl projects seven new drugs will be introduced worldwide in the next four years with 9-11 drugs to follow in the year 2000.
-- "New products can produce earnings growth of 15 to 17 percent through 1999 and Uhl expects Pfizer to earn $1.75 in 1997 and $2.05 in 1998," Shulman said in a report.
-- Shares were off 1 to 62. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 100 to 7862.
